theme.rules: RIGOROUS Dark Theme (#121212 background, #FF6B00 primary accent). Strictly NO blue or purple accents anywhere in the UI.

typography.alignment_rules: Headings and subheadings left-aligned by default. Center alignment used only for modal heroes and badge completion callouts.

visual_enhancers.card_style: Dark surface #1e1e1e with 1px border #2e2e2e, rounded-2xl (16px) or rounded-3xl (24px) corner radii.
visual_enhancers.button_style: Pill or rounded-2xl buttons with #FF6B00 fill, #121212 high-contrast text, 0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35) tactile shadow, active:scale-98 transition.
visual_enhancers.avatar_guide_bubbles: Card with subtle #FF6B00/10 tint, #FF6B00/30 border, 44px circular avatar of Mikila (the baker) or Mohammadreza with pulsed status dot.
visual_enhancers.progress_indicators: Sleek #FF6B00 filled bars over #2e2e2e track, with clear step count labels (e.g. 3/5 completati).
visual_enhancers.modal_overlays: bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md overlay. DO NOT use fully transparent overlays.

1_bake_along_step_by_step.title: Modalità Riproduci Passo-Passo con Avatar Mikila
1_bake_along_step_by_step.description: Interactive recipe execution mode guided by Mikila avatar.
features: Step header with current step index (e.g., Passo 2 di 6) and progress bar
Clear instruction card with large typography and encouragement tip from Mikila avatar
Timer and temperature badges (e.g. ⏱️ 20 min | 🌡️ 230°C in forno)
Previous / Next navigation buttons with active:scale-95 and data-testid attributes
Direct toggle to open the 'Shopping List & Equipment Guide' for this recipe

2_shopping_and_where_to_buy.title: Lista della Spesa & Suggerimenti DOVE Comprare
2_shopping_and_where_to_buy.description: Comprehensive ingredient and tool breakdown with purchase recommendations.
features: Auto-calculated quantities for ingredients based on target dough weight or recipe portions
Categorized items: Farine speciali, Lievito/Prefermenti, Liquidi/Grassi, Attrezzi & Teglie

WHERE TO BUY ('Dove comprare'): Suggestions for local mills (Mulino di zona), supermarket, organic store (Bio), or specialized online suppliers (es. teglia in ferro blu, raschietto inox, pietra lavica)
One-click copy or WhatsApp sharing of the shopping list

3_progressive_educational_paths.title: Percorsi Didattici Progressivi a Modelli
3_progressive_educational_paths.description: Clear step-by-step roadmap from beginner to master home baker.
levels: Livello 1: Primi Passi & I 4 Ingredienti (Farina, acqua, sale, lievito)
Livello 2: Focacce & Teghie Morbide (Alta idratazione, olio EVO e teglie)
Livello 3: Pani Tradizionali & Prefermenti (Biga, Poolish e crosta croccante)
Livello 4: Lievito Madre & Fermentazioni Lente (Rinfreschi, gestione e acidità)
Livello 5: Grandi Lievitati & Panettone (Primo/secondo impasto, pirlatura, raffreddamento capovolto)

4_rich_learn_landing_page.title: Landing Impara Ricca e Gamificata
4_rich_learn_landing_page.description: Content-rich educational hub with intuitive navigation.
components: Horizontal quick-access pills for fast scrolling (Livelli, Quiz, Chiedi al Maestro, Ricetta del giorno, SOS Impasto)
Recipe of the day spotlight card with ingredients & steps
Gamification progress bar showing overall level completion
AvatarBubbles featuring Mikila & Mohammadreza with actionable 'Take me there' links
Integrated Baker Quiz and BakeAlong weekly challenge

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST include kebab-case data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, modals). Examples: data-testid="bakealong-step-next", data-testid="shopping-where-to-buy-btn", data-testid="impara-path-focacce".
testing_and_accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on all mobile buttons and clickable cards.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Text contrast ratio > 4.5:1 against dark #121212 / #1e1e1e backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Enhance the IMPARA section adhering strictly to the Deep Black #121212 + Orange #FF6B00 theme.
Implement the step-by-step recipe execution mode with Mikila avatar guidance, step progress, timer/temp indicators, and encouraging notes.
Integrate the 'Cosa e Dove comprare' shopping list component with quantities and buying tips (supermarket, local mill, specialty shop, online).
Structure the learning levels in a progressive flow (Primi Passi -> Focacce -> Pani -> Lievito Madre -> Grandi Lievitati).
Ensure all 6 supported languages (IT, DE, EN, ES, FR, FA) render smoothly using mkTri or translation maps.
Add data-testid to every interactive component for testing validation.
